As an action, you can charge headlong up to twice your speed in a straight line, ignoring any opportunity attacks that would otherwise stop you. Every creature within 5 feet of your path must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw of its own choosing (DC equal to 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Strength modifier); a creature smaller than you rolls this save at disadvantage. On a failure, a creature takes damage equal to your Strength modifier plus your rage damage, and if it's no more than one size larger than you, it's shoved 5 feet in a direction you pick. If a creature is within 5 feet of you when your charge ends, you may make one melee weapon attack against it at no action cost, dealing extra damage equal to your berserker level on a hit.

Once you've unleashed this charge, you need a short or long rest before doing so again.
